name: Preventvital (GruentzigAI Pvt. Ltd.) - AI/ML Engineer Intern
stats: Found an ASCVD calculation defect (0.1% vs published 2.1%) · Wrote the clinical sign-off report
content: At Preventvital (GruentzigAI), Advaith audits the ML and risk-calculation code behind cardiovascular risk scores. He found a sign error in a coefficient of the ASCVD risk calculation that drove untreated patients to the 0.1% floor, reproduced the calculation against the published Goff 2014 coefficients (expected about 2.1% for the reference case), and wrote it up for clinical sign-off. The fix waits on that sign-off. He also drafted RAG and safety rules following ICMR 2023 guidance on an 'engine computes, LLM explains, clinician signs' protocol.
